source: Online softmax also has an earlier lineage. Milakov and Gimelshein described an online recurrence that computes the classical stable softmax normalizer with fewer memory accesses. ZXNAME0000XZ builds the same kind of running-max/running-normalizer idea into tiled attention, while also accumulating the value-weighted output.[2, 4]
zh: 在线softmax也有更早的血统。 Milakov 和 Gimelshein 描述了一种在线递归方法，可以用更少的内存访问来计算经典的稳定 softmax 归一化器。 ZXNAME0000XZ 将相同类型的 running-max/running-normalizer 想法构建到平铺注意力中，同时还累积了价值加权输出。 [2, 4]
